authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2830 karṇa explicitly gives northern kan/kaṇa and phonetic koṇ, with q/k and velar-nasal notation retained in the survey. Khowar kār requires comparison with the separate *kāra ear family. Reviewed comparator: Mai kāṇ “ear” (f_np4ngmworqu4q). Any uncertain transfer between Indo-Aryan languages remains open under the user’s preference; source phonetic details are preserved.
